run_migrate_imports_dry_run: run a dry run of the import migration tool on a Python or YAML file
run_migrate_imports_execute: execute the import migration tool to replace old fairchem import paths in a directory
run_migrate_imports_single_file: run the import migration tool on a single Python file to update import statements
refactor_replace_strings_in_file: refactor the replace_strings_in_file function to support additional file extensions beyond YAML and Python
review_mapping: review the import path mapping dictionary to verify old to new module path replacements
